DECRQSS \" q.reason: Thrush doesn't protect cells with DECSCA, which no recorded program sends, so it always reports 0.

DECSED 2.reason: Thrush doesn't protect cells with DECSCA, which no recorded program sends, so selective erase clears every cell.

DECSEL 2.reason: Thrush doesn't protect cells with DECSCA, which no recorded program sends, so selective erase clears every cell.

DECSET 1016.reason: Few programs ask for pixel positions, which need each view's grid size in pixels sent through to the PTY, so Thrush reports cells until it draws images.

DECSET 9.reason: No recorded program asks for X10 mouse reports, so Thrush reports the pointer only in the modes from 1000 up.
